blocks.title: Bubble sort
blocks.text: Bubble Sort repeatedly steps through the list, compares adjacent elements and swaps them if they are in the wrong order, until no more swaps are needed.

Bubble Sort is O(n^2), so it is inefficient for large datasets, but it is easy to understand and useful for teaching and small datasets. For larger datasets use more efficient algorithms like Quick Sort or Merge Sort (Tip).
